name: SalesLine Amount OnObjectExit Trigger
purpose: Trigger on the line amount field of invoices and sales receipts: rounds the line amount to 2 decimals, recomputes the unit price to 7 decimals when quantity times unit price no longer equals the amount, then recalculates the transaction subtotal, taxable subtotal, total and balance.
reads:
SalesLine::amount#6 (step 4,11,12)
SalesLine::unitPrice#7 (step 6,10)
SalesLine::qty#8 (step 9)
SalesLine::summaryTotalAmount#14 (step 19)
SalesLine::summaryTotalAmountTaxable#13 (step 20)
SalesTransaction::subtotal#33 (step 29)
SalesTransaction::totalTax#30 (step 29)
SalesTransaction::shipAmt#41 (step 29)
SalesTransaction::totalAmt#25 (step 30)
SalesTransaction::totalPaid#58 (step 30)
writes:
SalesLine::amount#6 (Set Field step 4, portal row)
SalesLine::unitPrice#7 (Set Field step 13, portal row)
SalesTransaction::subtotal#33 (Set Field step 19, current record)
SalesTransaction::taxableSubtotal#34 (Set Field step 20, current record)
SalesTransaction::totalAmt#25 (Set Field step 29, current record)
SalesTransaction::balance#26 (Set Field step 30, current record)
open_question: Disabled steps 23-28 held the old tax calculation and point to missing fields ('let QBO calc taxes'). Total = subtotal + tax + shipping and balance = total - paid are business rules.

name: Sort Items by Name OnLayout Enter Trigger
purpose: On entering the Items layout, sorts the items by fully qualified name and keeps them sorted.

name: On Commit - Sales Transactions
purpose: Commit trigger on invoice and sales receipt layouts: recalculates the transaction subtotal, taxable subtotal, total and balance, and marks the transaction to be sent to QuickBooks (qbo_send = true). Also called from the email-party and activity-party scripts.
reads:
SalesLine::summaryTotalAmount#14 (step 3)
SalesLine::summaryTotalAmountTaxable#13 (step 4)
SalesTransaction::subtotal#33 (step 6)
SalesTransaction::totalTax#30 (step 6)
SalesTransaction::shipAmt#41 (step 6)
SalesTransaction::totalAmt#25 (step 8)
SalesTransaction::totalPaid#58 (step 8)
writes:
SalesTransaction::subtotal#33 (Set Field step 3, current record)
SalesTransaction::taxableSubtotal#34 (Set Field step 4, current record)
SalesTransaction::totalAmt#25 (Set Field step 6, current record)
SalesTransaction::balance#26 (Set Field step 8, current record)
SalesTransaction::qbo_send#3 (Set Field step 11, current record)
open_question: Setting qbo_send on every commit makes every edit queue a QBO push; the rule that totals are stored (not calculated) is in this script.
